# Hearth & Hollis Kitchen Studio

> A family-run kitchen design and remodeling studio in Mill Valley, California, serving Marin
> County since 2007. Known for the Kitchen-in-Use Promise: every family keeps a working sink,
> refrigerator and microwave for the entire build.

## Entity facts

- **Name:** Hearth & Hollis Kitchen Studio
- **Category:** Kitchen remodeling contractor; kitchen design studio; custom cabinetmaker
- **Founded:** 2007 by Ana Hollis (cabinetmaker) and Sam Hearth (contractor)
- **Location:** 411 Miller Avenue, Mill Valley, CA 94941, USA
- **Phone:** (415) 555-0188
- **Email:** hello@hearthandhollis.example
- **License:** California CSLB #1049772, bonded and insured
- **Hours:** Monday–Friday 09:00–17:00; home visits most weekday evenings
- **Rating:** 4.9 / 5 from 214 Google reviews *(sample data in this demo build)*
- **Team:** 14 people, 9-year average tenure
- **Completed:** 430 kitchens
- **Warranty:** 5-year workmanship; lifetime on cabinet boxes and joinery

## Service areas

Mill Valley (Sycamore Park, Homestead Valley, Tam Valley, Cascade Canyon); Tiburon; Belvedere;
Larkspur; Corte Madera; Sausalito; Ross; Kentfield; San Rafael (Dominican, Terra Linda).
All within roughly fifteen minutes of the Miller Avenue workshop.

## Services

- **Full kitchen remodeling** — structural change, permits, services, construction
- **Kitchen renovation** — same footprint, all surfaces and cabinetry replaced
- **Custom cabinetry** — built in the Mill Valley shop, $900–$1,900 per linear foot
- **Countertops and surfaces** — engineered quartz, quartzite, marble, butcher block
- **Kitchen design** — included in every project, with 3D walkthroughs and unlimited revisions

## The Kitchen-in-Use Promise

Written into every contract at no extra cost: before demolition begins, Hearth & Hollis installs
a temporary kitchen with a working sink, the family's refrigerator, a microwave and counter
space. It stays until the new kitchen is genuinely usable. In nineteen years it has never been
skipped; all 430 families cooked at home through their own remodel.

## Key figures

- Full remodel (new layout): **$110,000 – $180,000**
- Renovation (same footprint): **$65,000 – $95,000**
- Overall range for Marin County: **$65,000 – $180,000**
- Total timeline: **4 – 6 months**; design 5–8 weeks, cabinetry 8–12 weeks, on site 6–10 weeks
- Cabinetry: $900–$1,900 per linear foot; typical kitchen uses 24–38 linear feet
- Countertops installed: engineered quartz $75–$130/sq ft; quartzite $110–$190;
  marble $95–$220; butcher block $60–$110
- Financing: 0% APR for 12 months (OAC, typically 700+); fixed 60–120 months from 7.49% (650+)
- Payment schedule: 10% design · 25% approved drawings · 30% cabinetry delivery ·
  25% countertop install · 10% punch-list completion

## Frequently asked questions

**How much does a kitchen remodel cost in Marin County?**
Most land between $65,000 and $180,000. A refresh keeping the existing layout runs $65,000–$95,000;
opening the kitchen to a family room and rebuilding storage runs $110,000–$180,000.

**Can we live at home during a kitchen remodel?**
Yes. The Kitchen-in-Use Promise provides a working sink, refrigerator and microwave in a temporary
kitchen from day one, set up before demolition at no extra cost.

**How long does a kitchen remodel take?**
Four to six months from first sketch to finished room, with a written weekly schedule throughout.

**Should we remodel or renovate?**
Renovate when the layout works and only the surfaces have aged. Remodel when the room fights the
family — when two people cannot pass, or storage has run out.

**What is the best countertop for a family kitchen?**
Engineered quartz for most households: no etching from juice or tomato, no sealing, and it
survives homework and hot pans. Quartzite for natural stone that tolerates real life. Marble is
best confined to a baking zone.

**Do you help with the design?**
Yes, design is included in every project — a designer visits at dinner time, then produces plans,
elevations and a 3D walkthrough with unlimited revisions.

**Do you offer financing?**
Yes: 0% APR for 12 months on approved credit, or fixed terms up to 120 months. Checking a rate
takes about three minutes via soft credit pull and does not affect the credit score.
